body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics launched a set of high-performance monitors that offer a seamless multi-display solution for optimal viewing opportunities at 2009 CES.

The monitors include a new 22-inch 'SyncMaster 2243QW', as well as the laptop companion monitors 'LD220' and 'LD190X'. All three monitors incorporate Samsung's UbiSync technology to help extend users' visual workspace by connecting up to six displays to a PC via USB cable.

UbiSync technology creates a multi-monitor system that can be operated from a single PC without a graphics card or complex software installations. The technology is especially valuable to users who desire portability and a larger, richer screen surface to help maximize productivity and visual effects.
